The complete VeriBugBench tree is not stored inside this git repo.

On each machine, scripts/setup_laptop.ps1 clones it to:

    C:\cv\VeriBugBench

and creates a junction:

    third_party\VeriBugBench  ->  C:\cv\VeriBugBench

Why a short path: some mutant paths exceed Windows' traditional 260-character
limit when nested under Documents\Chip Verification.

Always run VeriBugBench commands with --root C:\cv\VeriBugBench
(or use . .\scripts\env.ps1, which does that for you).
